name: Electrical heat tracing
principle: Electrical heat tracing maintains or raises the temperature of pipes, tanks and instruments by applying heat along the surface. Self-regulating parallel trace cables vary their resistance with temperature and cannot overheat a dry section, constant-wattage cables deliver fixed power, and mineral-insulated or skin-effect systems serve long, hot or high-power duties. Heating replaces or supplements steam tracing, and digital control panels monitor every circuit for current and temperature alarms.

process_steps.name: Cable type and output selected from heat-loss calculation
Cable applied along the line with terminations and junction boxes
Insulation installed; trace and sensor routing verified
Control panels switch and monitor circuits by ambient or line temperature

performance.basis: single-phase 230 V and three-phase 415 V tracing at Malaysian LV

limitations: design is a per-line engineering exercise: heat loss, exposure, maximum temperature and maintenance allowance all set the cable
damaged sections on long mineral-insulated runs are hard to locate without segmentation
advantages: eliminates steam tracing condensate systems and their maintenance
self-regulating cable removes the burn-out failure mode
